main_body: wooden pew with backrest, horizontal seat plank, front apron and side supports
top_band: warm tan/ochre horizontal seat surface with wood grain across rows 7-10 (below the vertical backrest at rows 0-6)
evidence: Reading a vertical column through the middle of the pew: rows 0-6 form the vertical backrest (dark brown top edge at row 0, light brown top rim at row 1, shaded backrest face at rows 2-5, deep crease shadow at row 6). Below the backrest, rows 7-10 (4 rows tall) form the foreshortened horizontal seat surface seen from above in lighter warm ochre/tan tones with subtle grain at rows 8-9 and a distinct 1px bright front-edge highlight at row 10. Below the seat edge, row 11 is a dark brown overhang shadow, rows 12-13 are the recessed front apron, and row 14 is the under-seat shadow gap between the side legs.

style.evidence: The wooden pew uses a 6-step warm brown ramp (from bright ochre highlights on the seat edges through light, mid, warm-reddish, dark, and deep brown shadows/outlines). The top and outer side edges use dark brown material tones rather than a uniform black sticker outline, the seat carries horizontal wood-grain variation across rows 8-9, and there are no 5x5 flat colour fills.
